justificativa: The patch propagates name changes from Student and Professor to the User, which covers the main case in the issue. However, it calls `user.update!`, which runs the User validations. As the official fix notes, those validations fail when the editor ranks below the user's role (for example, the secretary editing a student who is also an administrator), so here the exception would block saving the student. It also does not sync the name when an existing user is linked (`saved_change_to_user_id`).
